nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Light Facial Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: I have combo skin that is prone to acne. This cleansing oil smells great, but heavy fragrance is often not recommended for skincare. Pro- this is an okay oil for massaging black heads out. Cons- It could be a user error, but I dislike how the oil does a mid job of removing my waterproof makeup, doesn't fully emulsify, and clogs my pores. I hope it works for you, but I would not recommend purchasing this.
The ONLY cleanser that has cleared up my acne. It's amazing. I've recommended it to everyone and even got my boyfriend hooked on it!!!

I have very sensitive skin and tend to break out if I use something my skin doesn't like but this has been wonderful! I used to have very noticeable pores especially on my nose and blackheads but this cleared them up in one wash. One month later and my pores are hardly visible, my face feels smooth, and this hasn't dried out my skin at all. I'm half way through my bottle and plan to keep buying it!

What is so amazing about this product is that it actually works. I have used many cleansing oils from extremely high end to drugstore options. I have many that I love and many that I do not. This has an extremely thin, liquidy texture, so you have to be prepared for that. It is almost like water. Do not let that deter you from buying this product. What makes this so good is that it thoroughly cleanses your skin and removes make up exceptionally well. I like it so much I double cleanse with it at night especially if my skin is feeling dry. This is a super lightweight oil that could be used by anyone with any skin type. There is a slight fragrance. I do not find this to be bad however, it could be improved. I find that it is not that big of a deal because I will continue to use this product because it works very well. I have used cleansing balms in the past, but they can feel so heavy. This is super light weight on the skin and leaves behind no residue. I feel that is what makes this product a true gem and also not having any residual makeup on my face after cleansing. I would recommend this to anyone even if someone just has dry skin and wants a good cleanser. This is a great one. This is great for all skin types. My skin can lean on the side of sensitive, and the fragrance does not irritate my skin. I still feel that it could be improved. That is my only complaint. Great oil cleanser

love this product! it works so well to cleanse my face along with remove makeup! it is easy to use by itself or using a cotton pad if that's your preference. it leaves my face looking super clean and hydrated. i would recommend!

avis.titre: An Effective and Gentle Makeup Remover
avis.texte: I recently tried The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Light Cleansing Oil, and I have been extremely impressed with its results. As someone with combination skin, finding a makeup remover that effectively cleanses without stripping my skin can be challenging, but this product has surpassed my expectations. One of the standout features of this cleansing oil is its lightweight texture. It glides effortlessly onto the skin and emulsifies with water to remove makeup, dirt, and impurities. I appreciate that it does not leave a greasy residue, and my skin feels clean and refreshed after use. Another great feature of this cleansing oil is its effectiveness in removing makeup. It easily breaks down even waterproof mascara and long-wearing foundation, making it a reliable choice for thorough cleansing at the end of the day. I also appreciate that this cleansing oil is enriched with rice water, which is known for its brightening and hydrating properties. After using this product, my skin feels clean, soft, and radiant, without any tightness or dryness. I also love the subtle fragrance of this cleansing oil. It has a light, floral scent that is refreshing and not overpowering. The packaging is also convenient, with a pump dispenser that dispenses the perfect amount of product with each use. I highly recommend The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Light Cleansing Oil to anyone looking for an effective and gentle makeup remover.

This product is comparable to high-end options. It feels gentle, clean, and lightweight. I use it as the first step in my double cleanse routine, and it effectively removes most of my makeup. The only drawback is that around the eyes, this isn't as effective with removing it. However, overall, it performs well. It's light, and my skin doesn't feel stripped or dry after use.

I've never used this brand before but definitely want to try other products. This is a great first cleansing face wash. It's a nice light weight oil cleanser that helps remove makeup, dirk, grime, etc. I could tell a difference after one use how clean my skin was. It actually has been glowing where I haven't wanted to wear makeup.
I tried this product for the first time and I loved it and would definitely keep on using it.

I would definitely recommend but I would also pair it with a specific cleanser for eye makeup.

This cleanser is a great everyday cleanser. I've been using it when wearing everyday makeup and spf. It cleans effectively and is very gentle. I don't feel any residue after using and it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or irritated.
